page.overview:
Who is Hōshō?

He was noted to be a kind-hearted person who desires nothing more than peace for Konohagakure.

He wears the standard high collared, full body uniform of the Konoha medical ninja. He also has black hair and big black eyes.

As a medical-nin, Hōshō presumably has a high level of intellect, is well-versed in medical ninjutsu, and has excellent chakra control to perform medical procedures.

Hōshō was assigned to one of the two medical units that was deployed to provide backup for the Sasuke Recovery Team, and was disappointed to hear that they failed to retrieve Sasuke. He then informed Kakashi of the status of the other members of the team while they travelled back to Konoha.
